content:
Eva K: quick sync — finalizing guardrails for next week's rollout of 'cost-aware routing'. Need canary plan, flags, observability and fallback thresholds. Proposed: 5% canary per region for 24h, SLOs: p95 latency < 1200ms, 5xx < 0.5%, cost delta < +15%. Any major objections?

Sam R: sounds reasonable. question: is 24h enough to see regional spikes? I’d prefer 48h and staggered region rollout.

Mohit P: Ops perspective — staged by region makes sense. Start us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. 5% slice per region, wait for stability window before expanding. Add auto-rollback if 3 consecutive 5-min windows breach SLOs.

Liz H: For flags, propose keys: `feature.cost_routing.v1.enabled` and `feature.cost_routing.v1.canary_percentage`. Also add `feature.cost_routing.v1.fallback_model` for quick switch. Need forced fallback if KV cache miss rate > 10% or memory pressure > 75%.

Arjun (ops-bot): +1. Also suggest a synthetic smoke check every 10m: `curl -sS https://canary.redwood/api/health?mode=canary` expecting HTTP 200 and p50 < 400ms. If smoke fails 2x in a row, pause rollout.

Sam R: For A/B quality — run a 50/50 blind sample for a small set of beta customers and an internal eval suite. Collect ranking metrics and a simple human-blind quality score. Keep sample small (~1% traffic) to start.

Eva K: Draft launch criteria (must be met before promoting to full rollout):
- No quality regression on eval set (delta <= 1.5% vs baseline)
- Stability: no auto-rollbacks triggered within 48h of canary
- Cost: unit cost delta <= +10% during canary windows
- Observability: tracing, token-level cost, KV cache metrics enabled
- Signoff from SRE (Mohit) and Product (me)

Mohit P: Failure modes & fallback rules to encode now:
- If p95 latency > 1500ms -> auto-fallback to `baseline-text-1`
- If 5xx rate > 0.7% for 5m -> immediate rollback and incident alert
- If OOMs detected on GPU -> failover to `model-quantized-8bit-cpu`
- Circuit breaker: per-customer 429 after sustained >200 tokens/sec for 1m

Sam R: Implementation sketch for rollout flag payload:
```json
{
  "flag": "feature.cost_routing.v1",
  "canary_percentage": 0.05,
  "regions": ["us-west-2"],
  "fallback": "baseline-text-1",
  "smoke_check": true
}
```

Liz H: Dashboards to prepare: p95 latency (global + region), 5xx rate, token-cost delta, KV cache hit rate, error-by-region, canary traffic slice and per-flag breakdown. Add alert thresholds for the auto-rollback conditions.

Eva K: Action items: 
- Sam R: update rollout script + feature-flag API to support staged regions and percent slices (due Wed EOD)
- Liz H: build dashboard panels + smoke job (due Tue 12:00)
- Mohit P: implement auto-rollback rules in routing layer + add runbook (due Tue EOD)
- Eva K: consolidate launch checklist & stakeholder email (due Wed AM)

deploy-bot: scheduled canary job created: `cron: 0 */6 * * *` -> runs `canary-traffic-generator` starting now.

Sam R: I'll open the PR for the rollout script and tag @Liz H and @Mohit P for review. :thumbsup:

Eva K: thanks all. If anything trips the canary we'll reconvene Thu morning. :spiral_calendar:
